import json,time
def emit(record): print(json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
emit(dict(event="socket-import-begun"))
start=time.perf_counter_ns()
import socket
emit(dict(event="socket-import-completed",wall_perf_ns=time.perf_counter_ns()-start,socketpair_name=socket.socketpair.__name__,socket_module=socket.__file__))
emit(dict(event="socketpair-begun"))
wall=time.perf_counter_ns(); cpu=time.process_time_ns()
a,b=socket.socketpair()
finished=time.perf_counter_ns(); cpu_end=time.process_time_ns()
emit(dict(event="socketpair-completed",wall_perf_ns=finished-wall,cpu_ns=cpu_end-cpu,family=int(a.family),type=int(a.type),a_local=a.getsockname(),a_peer=a.getpeername(),b_local=b.getsockname(),b_peer=b.getpeername()))
a.close(); b.close()
emit(dict(event="sockets-closed",scientific_execution=False))
